wer_methodology_notes: Two normalizations emitted in parallel (see docs/eval-runs/wer-methodology.md). The internal column keeps digits + hyphens (slightly stricter; surfaces cosmetic ASR drift). The PriMock57-aligned column matches preprocess_text() in the dataset's scripts/utils.py exactly (alphabetic-only + hyphen→space) so the WER is byte-comparable against published baselines.

wer_primock57_aligned.notes: Lands at the low end of Moramarco et al. (ACL 2022) published baselines (23–30% across ASR systems). nova-3-medical behaves credibly on this corpus.

alert_thresholds.rationale: Anchored against the paper-comparable column so cross-system comparisons stay honest. Internal column tracks the same direction; either trigger fires when ASR meaningfully regresses.
